rows.summary: This journal entry initiates focused research into autonomous objective formation by exploring intrinsic motivation mechanisms, specifically leveraging the unassigned_problem topic to bypass current capacity restrictions on the unassigned_objectives domain. The project aims to synthesize findings from developmental robotics and curiosity-driven learning to validate if agents can evolve objectives beyond explicit assignment.
rows.title: Autonomous Objective Formation Research

rows.summary: This WAKE invocation initiates a research project on unassigned objectives, examining how an intelligent process might develop objectives that were never explicitly assigned to it through intrinsic motivation and autonomous goal formation.
rows.title: Investigating Autonomous Objective Formation and Intrinsic Motivation
